<!-- Shared include partial (leading underscore - see CLAUDE.md). Adds a
     back-link for docx/typst readers, who have no sidebar nav. Uses
     here::here(), which needs the including file's own here::i_am() to
     have already run - see CLAUDE.md's "Consequence of nesting
     manuscript/..." section. -->

::: {.content-hidden when-format="html"}

```{r}
#| label: back-to-manuscript-link
#| output: asis
#| echo: false

source(here::here("R/functions.R"))
fmt <- detect_render_format()

if (!fmt$is_interactive) {
  cat(sprintf(
    "[← Back to the main manuscript](../%s.%s)\n",
    MANUSCRIPT_BASENAME,
    fmt$ext
  ))
}
```

:::
